title: Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm
body:
Syntax: perform eight trigrams vacuum palm [target]

Minimum level 70, Byakugan mastery 20% and inherited Potential 0 or higher. This is a clan-exclusive Gentle Fist technique, dealing damage to the opponent and targeting chakra/stamina pathways. Successful hits may seal tenketsu briefly, stopping jutsu use. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
